description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for the SepLLM model, showing how the loss decreases as training progresses. The x-axis represents Training Time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000 s, with tick labels at intervals of 50,000 s. The y-axis represents Loss, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains two lines: a purple line with diamond markers and a solid line, and a red line with circular markers and a solid line. Both lines start at a high loss value near 2.75 at time 0 s and exhibit a downward trend as training time increases. The purple line begins at approximately 2.75 and decreases to about 2.50 by 250,000 s. The red line begins at approximately 2.75 and decreases to about 2.48 by 250,000 s. A green dashed horizontal line at 2.50 is overlaid on the plot, and a green dashed rectangle highlights a region from approximately 200,000 s to 250,000 s, with an annotation indicating a 1.26x multiplier, likely referring to the ratio of loss values at the start and end of the highlighted interval for the red line.
